page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture utilizing an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 72 dedicated physical cores and 72 vCPUs, indicating a one-to-one mapping with no hyperthreading enabled. It is equipped with 288.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring reliance on external network-attached block storage for data persistence. To support this architecture, the instance provides a high baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps, which facilitates efficient data transfer to external storage volumes and network resources. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated rendering or deep learning workloads.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers a high-density resource profile suitable for enterprise-scale workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of shared-core resource contention. The balanced CPU-to-memory ratio and high network throughput make this instance type appropriate for multi-threaded applications, web serving, application servers, enterprise databases, and distributed middleware.
